image_description: Two black loudspeakers positioned side-by-side on a white background. The speaker on the left is angled, showing its front grille and side profile with wheels at the base. The speaker on the right faces forward, featuring a large central woofer, a smaller tweeter above it, and a protective metal mesh grille covering the drivers. Both units appear to be professional PA-style monitors with rugged enclosures.
